evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: At the current tip, recover_kill_phase still accepts any nonzero, non-None exit code as proof that recovery was interrupted. A normal nonzero refusal from recover can leave the record unchanged in pending/drained, satisfying the later record assertions, so the test can report an interrupted recovery even if the drain kill hook never fired. Requiring rc == -9 is a routine test-correctness fix.
